label: Christoph Benzmüller and Bruno…, Gödel's…: Scott's axiom A1a: at every world, for every property…
locator: GoedelGod.thy, A1a: "[∀(λΦ. P (λx. m¬ (Φ x)) m→ m¬ (P Φ))]"
interpretation: Axiom A1a as stated in the theory, read through the theory's own abbreviations: validity [_] is truth at every world, ∀ quantifies over all properties, and m¬, m→ are pointwise. The theory glosses A1a with A1b as 'Either a property or its negation is positive, but not both'; this claim records only A1a, the 'not both' half. Attributed to the AFP formalization of Scott's notes, not to what Scott or Gödel intended.
